'''Lidan Bleeker''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who lived during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Bleeker was a professional [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] and during his career he served with the armed forces of several [[Planet/Legends|planets]] as well as within a couple of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] bands. However, he later found himself within job and he was enlisted by the [[Force Adept]] [[Dersa Welles]] into joining the [[Intarsa League]], a criminal faction that she led.

Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Bleeker and the rest of the Intarsa League were attacked by a criminal rival while traveling in a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] close to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and they crash-landed in the grounds of the [[Blue Star Centre]], a [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophical]] research facility. In desperation, Bleeker and the other Intarsa League members seized control of the Blue Star Centre and held its' inhabitants hostage in return for a ransom, passage off Cularin and assurances that the local authorities would apprehend the criminals who had shot down their shuttle. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]]&ndash;a band of freelance operatives that operated within the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]&ndash;[[Skirmish in the Blue Star Centre|attacked]] the Intarsa League and defeated Bleeker and his companions.
